correctness.rationale: For m≥2 loopless star and one updater-local bias r≥1, the (hub-status, A-leaf count) Markov chain has 2m transient states. Verified exact u_k and v_k harmonic functions satisfy both recurrences and boundaries symbolically; uniform single seed gives F_m=(mr+1)(mr+m+3r−1)/[(m+1)^2(r+1)(m+2r−1)]. Leaf-only bias changes no update; martingale/coupling yields hub superiority for r>1. r→∞ produces m(m+3)/[2(m+1)^2]=9/16−(m−3)^2/[16(m+1)^2] and r_m/m→theta gives theta/(1+2theta).
